output_envelope_review.finding: Not specified in reviewed official product page and its linked manual; not evidence of absent protection

integration_rules: 3S is a design alternative, not a user requirement
Never connect 3S directly to 3.7-6V servos or Tab5 battery input
Review all previous 2S monitor and auxiliary input ratings before reuse
Charger, per-cell low-voltage monitoring, fuse and reverse-input protection remain required design work
External UBEC switch is not proven physical or bidirectional isolation
Do not parallel two separate UBEC outputs
